study type: Prospective cohort study (secondary analysis of a control group from a randomised control trial) with cross-sectional components
cohort: The study included 55 full-term French-speaking mother-infant dyads.
finding: Maternal childbirth-related posttraumatic stress symptoms (CB-PTSS) were associated with poorer mother-infant bonding, but generally not with infant language, motor, or cognitive development.
